CC: Getting Started (iOS)

Quick Reference Guide

| This Quick Reference Guide (QRG) shows the basic functionality of the PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration (CC) Mobile Application for iOS. *\*Sections may have a corresponding link for more granular how-tos* |
| :---: |

| App Core Functionality |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---: | ----- | :---: |
| **(1) App Download/Login**  **Mobile App Device Requirements** Running minimum of iOS 16 or later See Additional device requirements [**HERE**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/16QzvGYYx01UdB4aBMUnSEpv-f7qH4btc1V383VWE9QE/edit?tab=t.0)  **Mobile App Download/Login** Open the App Store and search for **PerfectServe Clinical Collab** Download the application, open, and login **Username** \= Ascension email **Password** \= Ascension network password See Additional login steps for BYOD [**HERE**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1u0P2x62SWSsuztF6WbHZzbeeNyWV0RKgFW0zXfpojEM/edit?tab=t.0)  |  | **(2) Messages** Read, reply, and create secure text and voice messages with attachments. Access current or archived messages with a swipe of the toggle. ![][image1] [**Additional Information**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_fG93_zuFxoUHrYmPUDYu8dsSwdLK-1nNOHb-9ri_4o/edit?usp=sharing) | ![][image2] |
| **(3) Directory** Locate providers and staff, view schedules, and confirm who is on-call.  ![][image3] [**Additional Information**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jOlXjHWEWXwwTeAWni0qJkb7hcguiU7PZR_Sr7i8ZN4/edit?tab=t.0) | ![][image4] | **(4) Dialer** Dial the phone number of the individual you wish to reach. Your facility’s dispatch number will display instead of your personal number, so your privacy is protected. [**Additional Information**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QkLExK24PcuRUVVgFlCnoa9-S31JQ1ovjUYZC1EvlZU/edit?tab=t.0) | ![][image5] |
| **(5) Patients\*** View your patient(s) or all patients and care team assignments. Join/leave a patient’s care team.  Initiate messages regarding the patient to their entire care team or a specific individual.  [**Additional Information**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Q4YSVc7Np_InHkGjEk4J0IgVrqSY4jAAcBkYvu1hxVA/edit?usp=sharing) | ![][image6] | **(6) News** See informational announcements and news broadcasted from your facility. [**Additional Information**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z7dDc78-iGZoSn3Mi_h6rqRQ-RhMsdoC6iEJkuecg2o/edit?tab=t.0) | ![][image7] |

| App Menu Functionality *\*Dependent on user permissions* |  |  |
| ----- | :---: | ----- |
| **(1) Status** Adjust your status from ‘**online**’ to ‘**do not disturb**’ with a quick toggle. [**Additional Information**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1WpYBPUwQLoJZMBOhEq_W2LM6tONlHUuU4HkzDEVMx0Q/edit?usp=sharing) | ![][image8] | **(5) Profile** View your personal profile or add/change your picture. |
| **(2) Auto Response** Enable a predefined or custom automatic response to messages received.  [**Additional Information**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1dnK-p1JmMP4_p9J8cO0Sb4xLKek3uELfjAZjsAKwKcw/edit?tab=t.0) |  | **(6) Settings** Customize your alert, call, message, and security settings.  |
| **(3) Forward Pages** Enable message forwarding to another individual or broadcast group. [**Additional Information**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19XIqu_GWLGiJzzzBxTt7iscUxLeBHjFDiELE-NLvxAM/edit?usp=sharing) |  | **(7) Logout** How you would log out of the application. [**Additional Information**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1syo9M1uZsltOrFXy01_Cj37hvQveE3Wy_Yg6L0fPrwM/edit?tab=t.0) |
| **(4) My Rules** Enable rules that can be used to provide an auto response and forwarding of messages for a specific timeframe. [**Additional Information**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ayxVj-dRZpVVJ9zyTpwk7jnAg_eXZ2ZLoguDuCZupkk/edit?tab=t.0) |  |  |
